title: Book Club Website
description: A website for my book club with my friends, featuring database integration to store book ratings.

title: africActive
description: Volunteer-built website for a local nonprofit food distribution organization. Designed and developed to help the community connect with their programs.

title: Regular Show Quote of the Day
description: A daily quote generator pulling lines from the animated series Regular Show from an original corpus I constructed. Built for fans who want their daily dose of Mordecai and Rigby (and every other character).

title: Where To Watch NBA
description: A quick-lookup tool that tells you which streaming service carries your favorite NBA team's games. Built for NBA fans like myself who got fed up with never knowing where to watch nationally-televised games.

title: DocSearchBuddy
description: A document search utility that makes it easier to find what you need across technical docs and references quickly.

title: MINTGAME 2
description: The sequel to a demo game following the door-to-door discoveries of a mint salesman, this game is a narrative-driven open-world adventure developed in Unity and published on itch.io.

title: SONOdream
description: A music-based 2D platformer with puzzle elements created as part of a team of 3 developers in Unity and published on itch.io. Featuring original music produced by me!

title: LiminoVator
description: An unsettling horror experience based on an elevator, developed in Unreal Engine as part of the Ludem Dare 57 game jam.

title: Get Blocked
description: An 8-bit narrative-driven RPG developed using Bitsy and published on itch.io.

title: PizzaVR
description: A VR game featuring pizza delivery, non-nauseous rope-slinging movement, and a bustling city developed in Unity. Check out the demo on YouTube.

title: Stay Grounded
description: A VR video art piece exploring themes of identity roots through the lens of my college dorm room. Check out the experience on YouTube.

title: healpool Music
description: Electronic music produced and released under the healpool alias. Stream the full catalog on SoundCloud.
